CI HANDOFF (Q-1037 / GH #2364, parked 2026-10-08)
CI FACTS
- Backend gate was 15.5-32 min single runner; now ~7.8 min wall (samples 6m15s, 7m48s, 7m52s main run 37730036364). Target <=10 min met.
- Design: ci.yml jobs backend_static (static checks + --tails-only), backend_shard (matrix shard: [1,2,3], THE knob; job name 'Backend shard K/M'), aggregator named byte-exact 'Backend gate (mix letflow.check)' with if: always(), fail-closed (changes must succeed; filter false => static+shards skipped, else both success). A failed 'changes' job is now red (behaviour change).
- Sharding: ExUnit assigns sorted test FILES round-robin; scripts/test_parallel.sh TEST_PARALLEL_SHARD=K/M (TOTAL=N*M, OFFSET=(K-1)*N), global partition indexes everywhere, N pinned to 4 on every shard. mix letflow.check.static / letflow.check.test --shard K/M | --tails-only.
- Reading samples: run createdAt->updatedAt for the workflow; per shard look at 'test_parallel: runner ...' (CPU model), 'partition N elapsed=' and 'phase elapsed=' lines. Shards 5m02s/4m36s/7m30s: slice 9..12 is consistently +15-30% heavier.
- CPU variance: AMD EPYC 7763/9V45/9V74, Xeon 8573C/8370C/6973P-C; same code partition phase varied 546-1100 s unsharded; one starved-runner event (1800 s watchdog, Xeon 6973P-C) and one 60 s AC6 timeout. Postgres durability off (fsync, synchronous_commit, full_page_writes) ~13-19%.
- Mutex lessons: harness kills runs at critical memory; never restart killed batches on your own; run mix under the shared mutex; report honest gaps (e.g. 19/30 PollerTest runs). MIX_TEST_PARTITION needs MIX_ENV=test.
MERGED (main): #2346 merge_group/A3 filter, #2357, #2366, #2368, #2369, #2370, #2372 (shard script + hermeticity), #2373, #2374 (sharded gate), #2375 (AC6), PollerTest AC3 deterministic.
REMAINING
- test/letflow/engine/lua/executor_test.exs:518 and :817 poll 20x10 ms = 200 ms for an in-flight child; widen deterministically (script signals readiness).
- Slice 9..12 imbalance lever (rebalance file assignment) for a cheaper M=3; M=4 gains ~1.5 min but 7 jobs/PR risks the 20 concurrent-job limit.
- Tenant-template clone cost per shard setup (~70 s).
- TEST_PARALLEL env guard rules: tests spawning the script or run/1 must scrub TEST_PARALLEL_SHARD/TOTAL/OFFSET via Letflow.Test.TestParallelEnv; the guard test test/scripts/test_parallel_env_guard_test.exs has an empty allow-list; non-shard invocations set them to ''.
